pay.name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance on suspended days)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.26: for each scheduled day of a work_suspension whose kind pays (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED: at least 60% of the 平均賃金, art.12 — the three calendar months’ wages before the day over their calendar days, or work_suspension.facts.average_daily_wage; a higher rate under the work rules is facts.pay_rate). A worker paid by the day or hour is paid the allowance for the days not worked; a monthly salary that runs on in full meets the floor, so the allowance is paid with the salary deduction only where the suspension says so (facts.deduct_salary, SUSPENSION_DEDUCTION). A wage: remuneration, labour insurance wages and salary income. A partial-day shutdown (the day worked in part) is entered as SHUTDOWN_ALLOWANCE.

pay.name: 休業日の賃金控除 (salary for suspended days)

references.title: 民法 art.624(1) and 労働基準法 art.24: a monthly salary is reduced for the scheduled days of a work suspension not worked when the suspension records it (facts.deduct_salary, as the work rules provide, art.89(ii)), at the NO_PAY_LEAVE divisor (the calendar days of the month); the 休業手当 then follows from SUSPENSION_ALLOWANCE for an EMPLOYER_CAUSED kind. The day rate is the monthly salary over the calendar days of the month (period.month_days), whatever part of the month the period is.

pay.eligibility: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) ? terms.facts.pay_basis : "MONTHLY") == "MONTHLY" && work.days.exists(d, (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type != "REST" && d.day_type != "OFF" && !d.worked && has(d.suspended.facts.deduct_salary) && d.suspended.facts.deduct_salary == true)
pay.quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(d, (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type != "REST" && d.day_type != "OFF" && !d.worked && has(d.suspended.facts.deduct_salary) && d.suspended.facts.deduct_salary == true)))

references.title: 使用者の責に帰すべき事由による休業 (労働基準法 art.26: 休業手当 60% of the 平均賃金 (art.12) per scheduled day; excluded from the 全労働日 of the annual-leave 80% test, 平成25年7月10日 基発0710第3号) The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.facts.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).

name: 天災事変その他の不可抗力による休業

references.title: 天災事変その他の不可抗力による休業 (no 休業手当: not attributable to the employer, 労働基準法 art.26; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; e.g. a natural disaster or a scheduled power cut, 平成23年3月15日 基監発0315第1号)

name: 正当な争議行為（同盟罷業）

references.title: 正当な争議行為（同盟罷業）による不就労 (no wage for the days not worked, 民法 art.624(1); excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; non-strikers idled by a partial strike are not owed 休業手当, 最判昭和62年7月17日)
正当なロックアウト (a defensive lockout releases the wage duty, 最判昭和50年4月25日 丸島水門事件; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; an unjustified lockout is EMPLOYER_CAUSED)

name: 法令・行政命令による休業

references.title: 法令・行政命令による休業 (a closure or work restriction ordered under law, e.g. 感染症法 art.18 就業制限: not attributable to the employer, no 休業手当; excluded from the 全労働日 as force majeure, 基発0710第3号)
